summary: File names may not contain < > : " / \ | ? * or control characters 0 to 31, and may not end in a period or space.
questions: Which characters are not allowed in file names in Ansible repos?

answer_card.title: Illegal filename characters
answer_card.answer_md: Not allowed anywhere: `< > : " / \ | ? *` and characters 0 to 31 (like `\n`). Not allowed as the last character: `.` or a space.
